name: Chengdu KSW Technologies Co.,Ltd.
summary: Chengdu KSW Technologies Co.,Ltd., founded in 2010 and based in Chengdu, China, specializes in the development, manufacturing, and sales of advanced wireless channel emulators and radio frequency (RF) microwave signal generators. The company delivers a wide array of solutions designed for communication testing and simulation. These include systems for 5G testing, automated test environments, MIMO V2X applications, wireless communication network assessments, radio signal acquisition and playback, channel simulation, and comprehensive equipment performance evaluation. In addition to integrated solutions, their product lineup features individual high-tech instruments such as wireless channel emulators, vector signal generators, spectrum/vector signal analyzers, vector signal transceivers, all-in-one radio testers, telemetry remote control receivers, HBI high-speed buses and modules, and other specialized measurement tools. Their clientele is diverse, serving mobile communication operators, equipment manufacturers, various radio research institutions, entities within the aerospace sector, and broader scientific research communities.
